Press matters; appointment as chief mayor; Ruhr Settlement Association personnel matters; Essen water-sports exhibition, 1933; honorary citizenship for Hermann Göring; correspondence with Dietrich, Otto; Eulenberg, Herbert; Florian, Friedrich Karl; Hanfstaengl, Ernst Franz; Hitler, Adolf; Hinkel, Hans (advocacy for Rudolf Schulz-Dornburg; Folkwang Museum); Kelter, Willy (exhibition “Westfront 1933”); Lersch, Heinrich; Rosenberg, Alfred; Rübsam, Jupp (39ers' memorial in Düsseldorf); Schmidt, Robert; Terboven, Josef (Fighting League for German Culture); Wieprecht, Christoph; Winckler, Josef.
